reviews.text: This business is awesome ! Art The owner personally came to our house he could of easily sold us a new disposal and we were prepared to buy a new garbage disposal, but he quickly found that there was a bag from Walmart or somewhere trapped inside of it. He called this before he ever looked . His service was great. He is meticulous about everything he does and we were completely satisfied. We actually had him clean a couple of our intakes while he was here. We highly recommend him and will use him for any handyman work. We have at our home.
reviews.author: Wildpat Hanlon

reviews.text: Art repaired a chip on my concrete slab at the entrance to my house and painted the slab afterwards. He did a good job at a reasonable price. I would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Alfredo Rosa

reviews.text:
He is polite, helpful and did all the work we needed and then some. He did a great job assembling our pantry and putting up blinds for us. Plus, he fixed our door.
Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Nkechi Esan

reviews.text:
I recently had a water purification system installed under my kitchen sink, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! From start to finish, the Art’s service was outstanding. He arrived on time, was extremely professional, and paid attention to every detail to ensure the system was installed perfectly. His expertise and efficiency were impressive, and he left the area spotless after completing the job.

If you’re looking for the best handyman service in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, I highly recommend him. Quality work, fair pricing, and a fantastic experience overall. I’ll definitely be using his services again!
reviews.author: Rishabh Sharma

reviews.text: Art was very professional did a great job.  I had some family issues and he rescheduled without a problem. He was a pleasure to work with.
reviews.author: Marshall Sharp

reviews.text: Art is very good at communicating what needs to be completed the process and the work required. He is very thorough and precies. I have now worked on a few projects with him. He has always completed them on time and in budget.
reviews.author: Neha Bagga

reviews.text: Art is awesome! He’s very thorough, professional, and has great communication! He quickly fixed several problems in our home, took the time to explain each solution, and left his workspace cleaner than he found it. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Allison Medford

reviews.text: Arthur did an awesome job. Did various work within the house. He level set to make sure the work is competed correctly.
reviews.author: Jacob Philip

data.summary: The reviews appear highly authentic. They contain specific details about projects, varied customer names and writing styles, and a realistic mix of praise. The single 3-star review adds credibility. The Yelp discrepancy is due to an inactive placeholder page, not conflicting customer sentiment. This is a legitimate, well-reviewed local handyman service.
fake_signals: Potential for generic praise in some reviews
Limited negative feedback for a perfect score
authentic_signals: Specific project details (garbage disposal, concrete chip, pantry assembly, water purification)
Mention of owner's name and personal service
Reasonable review count for a local handyman
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google shows 4.9 with 43 reviews, while Yelp shows 0.0 with no reviews. This is a common pattern for small businesses where customers primarily use Google for reviews. The Yelp listing appears to be a placeholder with no actual reviews, not a low rating based on customer feedback.
